Application Data.NAME: ElectroSupplies Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ElectroSupplies Inc. specializes in the wholesale distribution of electrical equipment and supplies, including circuit breakers, wiring, lighting fixtures, and industrial control systems. Our operations involve sourcing high-quality products from reputable manufacturers, ensuring compliance with industry standards and safety regulations. We maintain a well-organized inventory management system, equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system due to our inventory exceeding $500,000, which significantly reduces the risk of theft and burglary. Our team has extensive experience in the industry, providing knowledgeable support to our clients while offering competitive pricing. Additionally, we minimize reliance on online sales to maintain a balanced sales channel mix, thereby reducing cyber exposure.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 07/15/2023, a shipment of electrical supplies was damaged during transit due to improper handling, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The claim has been filed and is currently under review with the shipping company. On 05/10/2023, we incurred a loss of $1,000 due to theft of inventory from our warehouse, which was promptly reported and is being processed by our insurance. Both claims are actively being monitored and we expect resolutions within the next few months.
